scope: Preserved source ideas, not tested combinations. Original fit claims retained only as historical observations.

ideas.name: Cozy + Smart
ideas.source_goal: A cute physical storeroom with one searchable terminal and a “find that chest” fallback.
ideas.source_notes: Great for a warm 1.20.1 pack where storage should remain visible.

ideas.name: Bulk + Brain
ideas.source_goal: Visible bulk commodities feeding a powerful autocrafting network.
ideas.source_notes: Let drawers handle huge single-item counts while AE2 handles variety and recipes.

ideas.name: Simple Network, Hardened
ideas.source_goal: The easiest chest-network workflow with performance patches available for heavy/older branches.
ideas.source_notes: Use only the optimization companion matching loader/version; benchmark in your exact pack.

ideas.name: Pretty Factory
ideas.source_goal: Visible pipes feeding upgradeable chests/barrels with easy farm intake.
ideas.source_notes: Fun to watch and pleasant to build around.

ideas.name: Create Warehouse
ideas.source_goal: Packaged physical logistics plus themed containers and bulk stock.
ideas.source_notes: The strongest “actual warehouse” fantasy; Create 6 logistics is newer than 1.20.1.

ideas.name: Magic Pantry
ideas.source_goal: Dimensional/magical storage plus beautiful physical bulk storage.
ideas.source_notes: Keeps technology out of a magic-heavy pack.

ideas.name: Fast 1.20.1 Pipes
ideas.source_goal: Efficient resource transport into controller-accessed drawers.
ideas.source_notes: New optimizer is worth testing, not blindly trusting.

ideas.name: Vanilla Chests, Superpowers
ideas.source_goal: Keep vanilla containers but make sorting, searching and box inspection painless with no server install.
ideas.source_notes: Ideal when you do not want a new storage progression at all.

ideas.name: Colony ME Warehouse
ideas.source_goal: Physical colony couriers backed by ME storage, autocrafting and Domum Ornamentum synthesis.
ideas.source_fit_claim: No — current addon is NeoForge 1.21.1 only
ideas.source_notes: Use AE2Colonies only on its verified 1.21.1 branch; required GuideME + Domum Ornamentum. Backup and test before permanent adoption.

corrections.verified_fact: Create 6.0.8 file create-1.20.1-6.0.8.jar explicitly supports Minecraft 1.20.1; this does not qualify all addons or a full pack.
